faqs.q: When is the expected handover date for Bashayer?
faqs.a: The villas are scheduled for handover in Q1 2030, while the expected handover date for the apartments is Q2 2030.

faqs.q: Are Bashayer home owners eligible for the 10-year UAE Golden Visa?
faqs.a: Yes, purchasing a property in Bashayer qualifies the buyer to apply for the Golden Visa, as the starting prices for apartments and villas exceed the minimum threshold of AED 2 million.

faqs.q: Is Bashayer a freehold development?
faqs.a: Yes, all nationalities can purchase property in Bashayer with full ownership rights.

faqs.q: What is the starting price for properties in Bashayer?
faqs.a: Prices for a one-bedroom apartment start from AED 2.5 million. Modon offers an attractive 50/50 payment plan with a 5% down payment on booking, 45% paid during construction and the final 50% due upon handover.

faqs.q: What amenities are available to residents of Bashayer?
faqs.a: Bashayer features a community centre, a children’s play area, a swimming pool, a park, green spaces, padel courts, a multi-sports court, a gym as well as cycling and jogging trails.

faqs.q: What types of residential properties are available in Bashayer?
faqs.a: The final phase of Bashayer will offer four- to five-bedroom villas and one- to four-bedroom apartments, townhomes, and penthouses.

faqs.q: Where exactly is the project located?
faqs.a: Tara Park is ideally situated in the heart of Reem Island, Abu Dhabi, directly opposite the premier lifestyle destination, Reem Mall. This prime location ensures that shopping, dining, and entertainment are just steps away, while other key landmarks like Al Fay Park, Sorbonne University, and Repton School are also just moments from the residence. Its strategic placement provides effortless connectivity, only 5 minutes from Downtown Abu Dhabi and the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), and 25 minutes from Zayed International Airport.

faqs.q: What is the expected handover for the project?
faqs.a: The estimated handover for this refined community is scheduled on early Q2 2030.

faqs.q: What world-class amenities are available for residents?
faqs.a:
Residents will enjoy exclusive access to a comprehensive range of amenities, including security services, a central swimming pool, a padel court, a multi-purpose sports court, a fitness studio, and a yoga studio. Tara Park will also feature open-air workspaces, a shaded garden lounge, a communal dining lounge, a dedicated co-working and study zone, a one-of-a-kind children’s playroom, a retail courtyard, an early learning centre, an art studio, and a social kitchen.
Additional retail shops, and dining outlets are available as part of the retail offering of Tara Park but will not be presented or managed by Modon.
Disclaimer: Please note the amenities may be updated before handover.

faqs.q: Are the properties in Tara Park freehold?
faqs.a: Tara Park is a freehold development, inviting both local and international investors to secure property within one of Abu Dhabi’s most prestigious and sought-after neighborhoods.

faqs.q: Does purchase of Tara Park qualify for the UAE Golden Visa?
faqs.a: Property investments in Tara Park exceeding AED 2,000,000 typically enable owners to apply for the prestigious 10-year Golden Visa, ensuring long-term security and residency within the Emirates.

faqs.q: Are there schools and hospitals nearby?
faqs.a: Yes, residents are just minutes away from world-class schools and hospitals including Sorbonne University, Repton School, and Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi.

faqs.q: Are the apartments equipped with smart home features?
faqs.a: Yes, each apartment is provisioned for home automation, allowing for smart home functionality.

faqs.q: What is the payment structure?
faqs.a: A relaxed 40/60 payment plan applies (5% on booking, 35% staggered, and 60% on completion). No alternative plans are available currently.
